metadata.title: Avoid full scan in ResourceCache cleanup loop
metadata.author: Nayana-R-Gowda

description:
Signed-off-by: NAYANAR <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>

closes #1818
ResourceCache cleanup by replacing the periodic full-cache scan with a min-heap–based expiration strategy.

Expired entries are tracked using a (expires_at, key) heap, allowing the cleanup loop to remove only entries that are actually expired. This reduces cleanup complexity from O(n) per run to O(k log n), where k is the number of expired entries.

commits.message:
fix: address thread-safety issues in ResourceCache

- Remove DualLock async context manager to avoid RLock thread mismatch
- Add locking to get() method to prevent race conditions with cleanup
- Add locking to __len__() for consistency
- Replace async cleanup test with sync _cleanup_once() tests
- Add tests for heap-based cleanup edge cases (updated/deleted entries)

commits.message:
fix: bound heap memory growth with compaction

- Add _compact_heap() to rebuild heap with only valid entries
- Trigger compaction when heap size exceeds 2x max_size
- Fix docstring: _lock is threading.Lock, not async lock
- Add tests for heap compaction behavior

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
perf: minimize lock contention during heap compaction

Move O(n) heapify work outside the lock to avoid blocking get/set:
1. Snapshot cache entries under lock (fast)
2. Build heap outside lock (O(n) but doesn't block)
3. Swap back under lock, preserving entries added during compaction
